name: Iris Klose
source:
Human.
Star Sign: Pisces
Occupation: High Wizard

She's currently an expert in all types of magic.
The party leader is Alfried, but she's the one that is really in charge.
Her class is a sage, but she doesn't really think deeply about things and has a haphazard and irresponsible personality.
She often fights with Alfried, and the reason the group got separated this time is her fault.
